scripts.build: pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend run codegen:check && pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend run lint && uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api --locked ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend run typecheck && uv run --project apps/api --locked mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src/caliburn
scripts.test: node --test scripts/run-app.test.mjs && uv run --project apps/api --locked pytest apps/api/tests/unit apps/api/tests/contracts -q -p no:cacheprovider && pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend run test
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.app:migrate: uv run --project apps/api --locked alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
